Therefore, it is important that you work carefully and always prioritize safety. You collect goods using replenishment slips, move them with the reach truck from bulk locations, and place them back in the correct location. You will work in a 2-shift system with times from 6:00 AM - 3:00 PM or 3:00 PM - 12:00 AM. Submarine Animation prides itself in its ability not to be confined to just one look or technique - putting the needs of each individual project front-and-center. As such, we work with 2D as well as 3D animation, digital as well as traditional crafts, and live-action/animation hybrids. About the Production: Submarine is slowly starting work on a new 2D animated feature film, developed as a co-production with JA Film (Denmark) and Doghouse Films. Our team will take on 2D animation and background production this Fall. The film is based on the graphic novel trilogy, Dansker, by Halfdan Pisket and tells the story of James, a man who flees a traumatic past in Turkey to start a new life in 1970s Denmark. Struggling with language barriers and limited opportunities, he finds himself pushed to the margins of society and drawn into a harsh criminal underworld, where survival comes at a cost. Directed by Jonas Poher Rasmussen (Academy Award-nominated for Flee), with animation direction by Liane-Cho Han (Little Amelie), the film combines frame-by-frame animation with deeply human storytelling.
